description: Video and audio generation via the fal.ai MCP — text/image-to-video (Seedance, Kling v3, Veo 3), text-to-speech (CSM-1B), and video-to-audio (ThinkSound). Use when the user asks to generate a video, a voiceover, music, or a sound effect with AI. Do NOT use for product or still imagery — SkyyRose product renders are OpenAI `gpt-image-2` only, via the `ai-image-generation` skill — and do NOT use for editing or assembling clips that already exist (that is video-editing / ffmpeg work, not generation).
